answer: Audits are entered in signal, queued in yarrow, and horizon publishes the wait time. A farm of 56 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 50 identities per epoch. A farm of 2768 identities would post 804 proofs and burn roughly 51 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
